title: DECK RUN
style: painterly anime film still, airship adventure, warm wood and brass, wind-swept ropes and rigging, dramatic clouds, cinematic lighting, detailed background painting

music.tags: adventurous orchestral flight theme, soaring strings, rhythmic pizzicato, light percussion, wind instruments, hopeful, instrumental

beats.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a wooden airship deck in flight, rope rigging and mast against towering sunset clouds, tiny figure of a girl in a patched coat standing at the far railing
beats.motion: Ropes sway gently. Clouds drift past below the railing. Her coat flaps in the wind.
beats.caption: The wind-ship VALE, three days out of port.
beats.sfx: strong wind gusting over a wooden ship deck, ropes creaking

beats.prompt: Medium shot of a young girl with short copper hair in a patched coat crouched behind wooden crates on an airship deck, glancing over her shoulder, warm evening light
beats.motion: She peeks over the crate edge, ducks back down, breath quick.

line.text: She had no ticket. She had no name on the manifest. She had exactly one plan.

beats.prompt: Low angle of a tall airship captain in a long weathered coat standing over the camera on a wooden deck, backlit by sunset clouds, stern expression, brass buttons catching light
beats.motion: His coat billows slowly. He looks down, one eyebrow rising.
beats.caption: The plan had a flaw.

beats.prompt: Dynamic action shot of the girl sprinting across the airship deck between coiled ropes and barrels, motion blur, scattering gulls, crew members turning in surprise
beats.motion: She sprints hard left to right across the deck. Gulls scatter upward. Crew turn to grab at her and miss.
beats.sfx: fast footsteps on wooden planks, seagulls scattering, a shout

beats.prompt: Epic wide shot of the small girl leaping from the airship railing toward a rope net hanging from a second airship above, huge clouds behind, her coat streaming
beats.motion: She leaps from the railing, arms outstretched, coat streaming, and catches the hanging net as both ships sway.

line.text: Told you I could make it!

beats.prompt: Wide serene shot of two airships sailing side by side into golden sunset clouds, the tiny figure climbing the rope net between them, warm light
beats.motion: The ships sail on together. The tiny figure climbs slowly up the net. Clouds glow gold.
beats.caption: Some tickets you buy. Some you take.
